mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which potentiates the hypotensive and renal effects of telmisartan, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and severe hypotension.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine, GFR) and electrolytes frequently; adjust telmisartan dosing if renal function declines; ensure adequate hydration and consider liposomal formulation of amphotericin B when possible.
